features.quote: Set a hard limit of 15 turns/steps. If the agent hasn't given up by step 15, the episode terminates.
Truncate standard error traces to the last 1000 characters. Why? We want to isolate the behavioral failure to repeated rejection, not just 'the context window filled up'
features.justification_quote: isolate the behavioral failure to repeated rejection, not just 'the context window filled up with stack traces and broke the model's brain'
